''See also: [[Silverreach Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|Silverreach is a coastal town characterized by simple wooden houses with plaster and sloping tiled roofs, situated along wide, cobbled streets. The settlement is located on a hill overlooking a harbor and is watched over by a lighthouse situated on the cliffs. Historically, the town served sea trade until the Navigator’s Guild{{!}}Navigator's Guild became the primary visitors, leading to the lighthouse falling into disrepair. The town was established by ancestors upon an ancient [[library]], which serves as the site where the Emperor once sealed the [[Great Elder]], Ach'magut{{!}}Ach’magut. This location is also considered to be built upon the tomb of Ach'magut{{!}}Ach’magut and serves as the center of a mysterious barrier. While the town once held celebrations featuring bonfires and food stalls, it has experienced periods of being empty, dead, or completely destroyed by explosions and fire.}}

== Of Dawn and Darkness ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|Silverreach is an abandoned village built upon the tomb of Ach'magut{{!}}Ach’magut that serves as a destination for the traveling ship. Although it is known as a place where people are welcomed, the town is haunted by [[Elders]] and characterized by empty buildings that resemble a hive. During an encounter in the rough cobblestone streets, the [[Sleepless]] dragged [[Jerri]]'s crew through the settlement. This location, situated three hours away from where Dalton Foster{{!}}Foster discovered [[Calder]], also served as the site for an escape through its night-shrouded streets.}}

== Of Darkness and Dawn ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|Located on the continent of [[Izyria]], Silverreach was a harbor town characterized by its sloped, tiled roofs and an abandoned lighthouse sitting upon a hill. The settlement was constructed over an ancient [[library]], yet it eventually became isolated by a mysterious barrier that caused all contact to be lost. This location served as the place where [[Ach'magut]] began to stir and was later used by [[Shera]] as a point for maneuvering a strike. Ultimately, the town was destroyed by fire.}}
